title: First time posting here—big fan of this community. Would love your thoughts on my latest devlog + card designs 🙏
author: Disastrous-Ad1744

comments.author: CaptPic4rd
comments.body: Beautiful frames and borders. What are you using to design those?

replies.author: Disastrous-Ad1744
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/dmlsnabrsfue1.png?width=3296&format=png&auto=webp&s=a2be68316e5de473b84dc0b8c450c78b829426b5

Thanks! I’m using a mix of AI tools, Photoshop, and Figma to put everything together. Lately, I’ve been experimenting with GPT-4o — surprisingly great at generating clean card frames and icons that I can then assemble in Figma. I'm a self-taught Figma guy, so my setup’s pretty basic, but here’s a screenshot from my last TCG showing the component workflow I’m using.
